posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Having now played half a game* with Paul and Christopher and a production copy at Expo, I can totally agree with Matchstickman that the finished product is in no way disappointing. It looks fantastic, and I even actually quite like the card icons now after arguing against them during playtesting. It all looks and feels as good as I hoped it would and I am very excited to get my own copy.

 

* All I managed to do before the hordes descended and the non-stop demoing of Compounded began. Let me tell you, I can now demo that game in my sleep (and I probably did at some point).
